name: Augury

header.Components: V, S, M (specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinatory tokens worth 25+ GP)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinatory tokens worth 25+ GP

authored_intent: Use 25-GP divination implements; pin a planned course within 30 minutes; authored Weal/Woe/Weal-and-Woe/Indifference answer; cumulative 25-percent no-answer chance after first cast before Long Rest, not a fabricated random omen; captured uncertainty.

rules.text: You receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes.
The GM chooses the omen from the Omens table.

Omens Omen For Results That Will Be … Weal Good Woe Bad Weal and woe Good and bad Indifference Neither good nor bad The spell doesn’t account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results.
If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
